info.description: Company and domain due diligence for AI agents: official registers, LEI, VAT, sanctions lists and domain records as signed JSON, each field with its source and retrieval time. Endpoints: due-diligence, company, company-de, domain, network, sanctions, vat. Every answer cites its official source, source URL and retrieval time, is signed (Ed25519, public keys at /.well-known/agosint-keys.json) and carries a note to verify at the source; it is not legal, compliance or credit advice. Payment is in stablecoins: x402 on Base and Polygon (plus Solana on most routes) or MPP on Base. x402 uses the exact scheme; no API keys, accounts or subscriptions. A lookup that finds nothing, or that a source cannot answer, is never charged. A free preview shows what a call would return. Feedback is free: POST /feedback (or the MCP tool feedback) sends a note to the people who run the service. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and RateLimit-Policy headers: they show the per-IP budget of the request class (free documents 120 per minute, unpaid quote requests 300 per minute; a request that carries a payment is never limited). Free GET documents (/openapi.json, /llms.txt, /agents.md, /pricing.md, /docs, /ask and /health) are limited to 120 requests per minute per client IP and return RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and RateLimit-Policy; a 429 also includes Retry-After. API deprecation policy: https://agosint.shveik.dev/deprecation-policy.

info.x-guidance: POST a small JSON body (see each operation's requestBody) with no payment to get a 402 carrying a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402) and a WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge (MPP). Sign either and retry the same request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (x402) or Authorization: Payment (MPP) to receive the JSON dataset. The 402 quotes the price for your requested limit: a fixed per-call fee plus a per-result price for each result; endpoints without a limit field return one result. If fewer results come back than you asked for, the per-result price of the missing ones is refunded on-chain to the paying address (refunds too small to be worth a transfer are not sent); a scrape with no results keeps only the fixed fee and refunds every result; a failed scrape is not settled. Response headers X-Agdata-Results-Requested, X-Agdata-Results-Delivered and X-Agdata-Refund (USDC base units) report it. On due-diligence, a call that delivers nothing is not settled and nothing is kept for it (502, error not_fetched). On company, a call that delivers nothing is not settled and nothing is kept for it (502, error not_fetched). On company-de, a call that delivers nothing is not settled and nothing is kept for it (502, error not_fetched). On domain, a call that delivers nothing is not settled and nothing is kept for it (502, error not_fetched). On network, a call that delivers nothing is not settled and nothing is kept for it (502, error not_fetched). On sanctions, a call that delivers nothing is not settled and nothing is kept for it (502, error not_fetched). On vat, a call that delivers nothing is not settled and nothing is kept for it (502, error not_fetched). due-diligence, company, company-de, domain, network, sanctions and vat can take up to about 120 s: keep the connection open; retrying with the same payment returns the stored result. company-de is not offered on Solana. Results are returned as one JSON array; limit is a maximum-result count (clamped to endpoint bounds). Paid results have no cursor or continuation token; the only paginated resource is the free GET /endpoints list (limit, cursor, next_cursor). Calls are synchronous; scrape timeout is bounded by configured upstream and settlement windows. An occasional 202 means settlement may have reached the chain, not an asynchronous job; retry the same payment to resolve/retrieve, and there is no status URL.

post.description: Business registry lookup: company identity and legal entity enrichment as structured JSON, by registration number, name and country, VAT number, LEI or website. Registers of Czechia, Norway, the United Kingdom, France, Finland, US SEC filers and every LEI holder. Use when: you need the official identity of one company. Send the JSON body with no payment to get a 402 with an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate) and an x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED); sign the MPP one (evm/authorization) and retry with an Authorization header. Both paths take either protocol: /x402/<name> and /mpp/<name> are the same endpoint. GET /mpp/company with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape.

country.description: two-letter ISO country code; required with id or name; CZ, NO, GB and US have their own official register, any other country is looked up in GLEIF

domain.description: a company website as a bare domain: the legal entity is identified from the site's legal notice, certificate and public records and its register record returned; not charged when the site cannot be tied to one company

id.description: the register id: CZ ICO, NO organisation number, GB company number, US ticker or CIK, or a registration number for other countries

lei.description: a 20-character legal entity identifier (any country; no country needed); when the entity's own register is one we read, that record is returned with the LEI and its parents

name.description: a company name; several matches return a short candidate list with ids

vat.description: a VAT number of a country whose number contains the register id (CZ, FR, FI, NO); no country needed. Send exactly one of id, name, lei, vat or domain

post.description: Sanctions screening against the official OFAC SDN, EU consolidated and UK lists with fuzzy name matching, a score per hit, the programme and each list's publication date. Screen a company or person name (optionally with country or birth date) or a crypto wallet address. Use when: screening a counterparty, supplier, customer or wallet before a payment or onboarding. A screening aid, not a compliance determination. Send the JSON body with no payment to get a 402 with an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate) and an x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED); sign the MPP one (evm/authorization) and retry with an Authorization header. Both paths take either protocol: /x402/<name> and /mpp/<name> are the same endpoint. GET /mpp/sanctions with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape.

birth_date.description: a person's birth date, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD; reported as corroboration of each hit

country.description: the subject's country (ISO code or English name); reported as corroboration of each hit, it does not change the score

kind.description: restrict matches to organisations (and vessels, aircraft) or to persons

lists.description: the lists to screen (default: all four)

name.description: the company or person name to screen; send either name or wallet

threshold.description: the lowest match score reported; 1.00 is an exact name or alias, 0.98 the same words in another order, lower scores are fuzzy matches

wallet.description: a crypto wallet address; an exact match against the digital-currency addresses listed on the OFAC SDN list (EVM addresses are case-insensitive)

post.description: German commercial register (Handelsregister) record: register court and number, legal form, status, seat, capital, representation rules, officers and history. Slower (about a minute). Use when: the company is German. Send the JSON body with no payment to get a 402 with an x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED) and an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate); sign the x402 one (exact scheme) and retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Both paths take either protocol: /x402/<name> and /mpp/<name> are the same endpoint. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon. GET /x402/company-de with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape.

include_deleted.description: also return companies deleted from the register

legal_form.description: legal form, e.g. GmbH or AG

limit.description: most company records to return and pay for (1 to 5, default 1)

match.description: how the words of the name combine

name.description: company name words as in the register

domain.description: a public domain name such as example.com (an internationalised name is accepted); no URL, port or IP address

post.description: Company due diligence in one call (KYB, vendor and supplier checks). Give a company name and country, a registry number, an EU VAT number, an LEI or a website domain. Returns the legal entity from the official register, LEI and parents, VAT validity, a sanctions screen (OFAC, EU, UK) of the company and officers, and the domain's age, mail and TLS, as signed pass/warn/fail checks with sources. Use when you must decide whether to trust an unknown company. Send the JSON body with no payment to get a 402 with an x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED) and an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate); sign the x402 one (exact scheme) and retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Both paths take either protocol: /x402/<name> and /mpp/<name> are the same endpoint. GET /x402/due-diligence with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape.

country.description: two-letter ISO country code; required with name or id; not used with lei, vat or domain

domain.description: the company's website as a bare domain such as example.com; the legal entity is identified from the site's own legal notice, its certificate and public records, and the call is not charged when it cannot be

id.description: a register number of the country (CZ ICO, NO organisation number, GB company number, FR SIREN or SIRET, FI business id, DE register number such as HRB 12345, US CIK or ticker); use with country

include.description: the sections wanted; default all five

name.description: a company name; use with country. Send exactly one of name, id, lei, vat or domain

vat.description: an EU or Norwegian VAT number with its country prefix, such as CZ45274649

post.description: Sanctions screening against the official OFAC SDN, EU consolidated and UK lists with fuzzy name matching, a score per hit, the programme and each list's publication date. Screen a company or person name (optionally with country or birth date) or a crypto wallet address. Use when: screening a counterparty, supplier, customer or wallet before a payment or onboarding. A screening aid, not a compliance determination. Send the JSON body with no payment to get a 402 with an x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED) and an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate); sign the x402 one (exact scheme) and retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Both paths take either protocol: /x402/<name> and /mpp/<name> are the same endpoint. GET /x402/sanctions with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape.

birth_date.description: a person's birth date, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD; reported as corroboration of each hit

country.description: the subject's country (ISO code or English name); reported as corroboration of each hit, it does not change the score

kind.description: restrict matches to organisations (and vessels, aircraft) or to persons

lists.description: the lists to screen (default: all four)

name.description: the company or person name to screen; send either name or wallet

threshold.description: the lowest match score reported; 1.00 is an exact name or alias, 0.98 the same words in another order, lower scores are fuzzy matches

wallet.description: a crypto wallet address; an exact match against the digital-currency addresses listed on the OFAC SDN list (EVM addresses are case-insensitive)

post.description: EU VAT number validation against the official VIES service: valid or invalid, registered name and address, an optional check of the name you expect and, if you give your own VAT number, a VIES consultation number to keep as audit evidence. Norwegian numbers are checked against the Norwegian VAT register. Use when: onboarding an EU supplier or customer, or before paying an invoice. Send the JSON body with no payment to get a 402 with an x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED) and an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate); sign the x402 one (exact scheme) and retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Both paths take either protocol: /x402/<name> and /mpp/<name> are the same endpoint. GET /x402/vat with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape.

expect_name.description: the company name you expect; the answer says whether it matches the registered name (match, partial, mismatch or not_checked)

requester_vat.description: your own EU VAT number: VIES then issues a consultation number, proof of the check to keep as audit evidence (not for Norwegian numbers)

vat.description: the VAT number to check, with its country prefix (an EU member state, or NO for Norway), e.g. CZ45274649
